answer.text: Beneficiaries and their beneficial interests are ascertainable as per the Trust Deed

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 9.2.1, Determinate Trust = beneficiaries and their interests ascertainable from the Trust Deed. **The Trap:** Discretionary/indeterminate trusts fall under Section 164 and attract MMR. **Cross-Exam Context:** Core trust-taxation distinction. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Set up as Determinate Trust where possible — offers better tax treatment.
